_two_editions_one_page: The maker publishes the standard model and the Super Clock model on ONE page, « DSDAC 1.0 （standard model / Super clock model） », with ONE parameter list, and states the difference as a clock with « RMS jitter is as low as 100fs » and « Some advance component are used ». Nothing this catalogue records separates them, so the Super Clock is an EDITION alias of this record, not a record of its own. The Deluxe model has its own page, its own output levels and a pre-amp mode, and has its own record: cengrand/dsdac-1-0-deluxe.
